s01b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s01b02.text: So, let's say there's a Twitter user...

s01b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s01b03.text: crying, and running from the void.

s02b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s02b06.text: And he sees all of this.

s03b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s03b01.text: So Jesus walks right up to the void,

s03b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s03b04.text: and starts whispering in its ear.

s03b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s03b06.text: Nobody knows what he said. I have theories.

s04b05.speaker: NARRATOR
s04b05.text: And then the void starts laughing. Maniacally.

s04b07.speaker: NARRATOR
s04b07.text: So hard, it's coughing up stars...

s05b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s05b01.text: Then Jesus looks at the Twitter user,

s05b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s05b02.text: who's, like, on their ass, with their hand up,

s05b04.speaker: JESUS

s07b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s07b01.text: Now the void whispers into Jesus's ear.

s07b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s07b06.text: And Jesus is just nodding along.

s08b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s08b01.text: Then the void crosses its arms, and scowls at the Twitter user.

s08b03.speaker: JESUS
s08b03.text: The void says it wants to talk to you,

s09b03.speaker: USER
s09b03.text: I'm not talking to that scary thing.

s10b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s10b01.text: So the void rolls its eyes,

s10b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s10b04.text: and turns its back on the Twitter user.

s10b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s10b06.text: In fairness to the void, it hears that a lot.

s11b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s11b01.text: And Jesus gets that look on his face.

s12b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s12b01.text: So Jesus puts his hand on the void's shoulder.

s13b03.speaker: JESUS
s13b03.text: You don't have to talk to the void.

s13b09.speaker: JESUS
s13b09.text: You were crying before it ever showed up, you know.

s13b06.speaker: JESUS
s13b06.text: But what about talking to me?

s13b07.speaker: JESUS
s13b07.text: And it doesn't have to be about the void.

s13b11.speaker: JESUS
s13b11.text: and the emotions that you're feeling.

s13b13.speaker: JESUS
s13b13.text: Because I want to talk to you more about emotions!

s14b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b01.text: And then the Twitter user gets up, and storms off.

s14b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s14b06.text: For talking about the void, too intensely.

s15b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s15b01.text: And Jesus looks back at the void,

s15b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s15b03.text: And the void pats him on the shoulder,

s16b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b01.text: So Jesus puts his arm around the void, and they walk off, toward the horizon.

s16b02.speaker: JESUS
s16b02.text: So a neutron asks the bartender, how much for a drink?

s16b10.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b10.text: Jesus, smiling a bit, telling it more dumb jokes,

s16b11.speaker: NARRATOR
s16b11.text: and the void, slightly giggling, in the distance.

s17b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s17b02.text: Now I'm imagining, when the void opened up the cage,

s18b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s18b01.text: that right behind the big body of the void,

s18b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s18b03.text: With its dagger, and its numbing dust, ready.

s18b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s18b04.text: And it's, like, licking its lips, going,

s18b06.speaker: MAGICIAN
s18b06.text: Can't wait to knock Fear out.

s19b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s19b02.text: And the void can see it.

s19b03.speaker: NARRATOR
s19b03.text: Just, in the corner of its eye.

s20b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b01.text: But instead of shouting, or making it obvious to my fear,

s20b02.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b02.text: that there's a creepy magician trying to stab it,

s20b04.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b04.text: kicks the magician in the chest,

s20b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s20b06.text: And the magician goes flying, right into the buckets and the cleaning supplies,

s22b01.speaker: NARRATOR
s22b01.text: And then it goes right back to showing my fear the galaxies.

s22b04.speaker: FEAR
s22b04.text: Why are you showing me this?

s22b06.speaker: NARRATOR
s22b06.text: To distract my fear, from the fact that the void had to kick the depression magician in the chest,

s22b07.speaker: NARRATOR
s22b07.text: Just so it could have a moment,
